method: Chapter titles and numbers for all 12 registered books were read from the PDFs themselves (pdftotext page 1-2) or from A2 page-1 headings; extraction status is a count of steps/A2/out/<BOOK>-ch<NN>-p*.runA.json files actually on disk. A4 subtopic files are keyed without an edition letter and every one of them references latest-edition passage ids, so a4_subtopics is reported only under `latest`.
